title: Spend an evening at the Metropolitan Opera
description: Make an evening of an opera at the Met: arrive early, look into the grand auditorium, and read a short synopsis before the orchestra begins. Singers, musicians, costumes, and scenery work together to tell a story at enormous scale. Choose a production that intrigues you; the performance rewards attention even when the language is new.
teaser: Let an opera unfold on the Met’s vast stage.
goodToKnow: Seated; choose a suitable running time and current January-February production.
whyItMightDelightYou: The combined force of live voices and orchestra can make even a familiar story feel immediate.
